tex_content.html:
Lemma
[equality gives pointwise proportional arc length] 1. ch9:2.3

↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-3-equality-case ↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-3-arclength-bridge In the situation of section 1, for every $t\in [a,b]$, \[ L\big(c|_{[a,t]}\big)=\frac{L(c)}{b-a}(t-a). \] Thus the parameter of $c$ is proportional to arc length pointwise, not merely almost everywhere.
Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-3-equality-case ↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-3-arclength-bridge By section 1, the speed of $c$ equals $L(c)/(b-a)$ almost everywhere on $(a,b]$. Restricting this equality to $(a,t]$ and integrating gives $L(c|_{[a,t]})=(L(c)/(b-a))(t-a)$. The identification of this integral with path length is section 1. $\square $

□
